title: Investigation into Alleged Bullying Case at Mee Toh School
what_it_is: Investigation into Alleged Bullying Case at Mee Toh School

sections.label: Mee Toh School incident discipline
sections.summary: Mee Toh School investigated the incident and counselled and disciplined the few responsible students, aiming to help children understand mistakes and restore relationships.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Mee Toh School has investigated the incident and the few students responsible for the acts have been counselled and disciplined.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Our primary approach is to help children understand their mistakes and restore relationships.

sections.label: Students disciplined, details undisclosed
sections.summary: The students were also disciplined, but MOE prefers not to disclose the details.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The students were also disciplined, but MOE prefers not to disclose the details here.

sections.label: MOE school bullying procedures assessment
sections.summary: MOE assessed the school had bullying SOPs, acted without delay and appropriately, and cited the 2021 CCE Curriculum and peer support culture.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MOE's assessment is that the school has Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) in place to deal with bullying incidents.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In this case, the Form Teacher and school had acted without delay, and the follow-up actions were appropriate.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The 2021 revised Character and Citizenship Education (CCE) Curriculum will teach pro-social behaviours, respect, care and empathy.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MOE will also support all schools in establishing a peer support culture so that every student understands that bullying is wrong and learns how to extend help and support to those who have been bullied.

sections.label: MOE satisfied school acted appropriately
sections.summary: MOE looked into this instance and was satisfied that the school had acted appropriately.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: In this particular instance, when MOE looked into it, we were satisfied that the school had acted appropriately.
